title: Zero-Trust Service Mesh & eBPF Security Architecture
subtitle: Cryptographic workload identity (SPIFFE/SPIRE), Cilium eBPF kernel microsegmentation, OPA policy enforcement, and dynamic secrets vault.

overview.summary: An enterprise defense-in-depth zero-trust architecture replacing perimeter firewalls with workload-level cryptographic identity, continuous kernel-level network enforcement via eBPF, and fine-grained authorization policies.
overview.problemStatement: Traditional network perimeter firewalls leave internal East-West traffic vulnerable to lateral movement once an attacker breaches the perimeter boundary.
corePrinciples: Never trust, always verify: every single RPC requires continuous cryptographic proof of identity
eBPF kernel-level filtering bypassing Linux TCP/IP stack overhead for line-rate security inspection
Short-lived X.509 SVID credentials rotated automatically every 60 minutes
Declarative Open Policy Agent (OPA) gatekeeping every mutating API action

data.label: SPIFFE / SPIRE Server
data.subtitle: Workload Identity Authority
data.description: Attests node hardware and pod runtime tokens, issuing short-lived X.509 SVID identity documents without static credentials.

specs.failoverStrategy: Raft quorum with local agent disk caching

data.label: Cilium eBPF CNI
data.subtitle: Kernel-Level Microsegmentation
data.description: Runs sandboxed eBPF bytecode inside Linux kernel sockets to enforce L3/L4/L7 policies and accelerate container networking.

data.label: Istio Ambient Mesh
data.subtitle: Sidecarless mTLS Layer
data.description: Lightweight node-level ztunnel proxy terminating mutual TLS and enforcing identity without bloated per-pod sidecars.

data.label: OPA & Styra Policy Engine
data.subtitle: Fine-Grained Rego Authorization
data.description: Evaluates declarative Rego policies (RBAC/ABAC) over streaming JSON context for zero-latency authorization checks.

data.label: HashiCorp Vault Cluster
data.subtitle: Dynamic Ephemeral Secrets & KMS
data.description: Issues dynamic database credentials with 15-minute TTLs and performs envelope encryption with hardware HSM backends.

data.label: SIEM & Tetragon Runtime Audit
data.subtitle: eBPF Real-time Threat Detection
data.description: Tetragon kernel sensor intercepting process execution, namespace escapes, and unauthorized socket connects in real time.
Synchronizes identity mapping to eBPF kernel maps.
Mutual TLS handshake with short-lived X.509 certs.
Rego rules evaluate permissions in sub-millisecond.
Continuous telemetry streaming to SIEM for security analytics.

simulationFlow.title: SPIRE Server Issues Cryptographic Workload SVID
simulationFlow.description: Payment service pod boots. SPIRE Agent verifies K8s service account token and TPM endorsement, issuing a 1-hour X.509 SVID.

simulationFlow.title: Cilium eBPF Inspects Socket at Kernel Level
simulationFlow.description: Service initiates outbound gRPC connection. eBPF socket filter verifies source identity and validates destination network security policy.

simulationFlow.title: OPA Evaluates Fine-Grained ABAC Policy
simulationFlow.description: Open Policy Agent compiles request parameters against Rego policy rules, ensuring calling service is authorized for requested ledger balance mutation.

simulationFlow.title: Vault Issues Dynamic 15-Minute Ephemeral DB Credential
simulationFlow.description: Vault dynamically spins up an ephemeral database username and password in PostgreSQL that self-destructs after 15 minutes.

simulationFlow.title: Tetragon Kernel Sensor Logs Auditable Execution Trace
simulationFlow.description: eBPF Tetragon probe logs process and network socket telemetry to SIEM for real-time compliance auditing and zero-day intrusion defense.

tradeoffs.decision: Ambient Mesh (ztunnel) vs Per-Pod Sidecar Proxies
pros: Saves over 60% memory and CPU overhead compared to injecting Envoy in every pod
Zero pod restarts required during mesh security upgrades
rejectedAlternatives: Traditional Istio Sidecar Injection into every container

securityAndCompliance.implementation: Default-deny eBPF microsegmentation isolating pods even within the exact same Kubernetes namespace.
100% ephemeral short-lived credentials with zero hardcoded API keys or static database passwords in git.
